senses.gloss: m. (cmp. נָפִיל) [giant,] the constellation of Orion (h. כְּסִיל).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 9:9">Targ. Job IX, 9</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 38:31">Ib. XXXVIII, 31</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="N01041"><he>נְפִילִין</he></cite>, constr. <he>נְפִילֵי</he>, <cite ref="N01061"><he>נִפְלֵי</he></cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 13:10">Targ. Is. XIII, 10</cite> (h. text <he>וכסיליהם</he>).—
Snh. 96ᵇ בר נפלי son of giants (?), surname of the Messiah (with allus. to הנפלת, Am. IX, 11); Yalk. Am. 549 (some ed. נְפִילֵי).
